## Continue Playing and Hidden Games

- **Continue Playing only shows games you started recently**: anything played in the last 30 days (through Starlight, or on the PC according to Steam) plus the game that's running, newest first. Pinned games no longer get pushed into the row (pinning is for the app icon). When nothing was played recently the row is hidden and Home features the first game of Ready to Play.
- **New Settings → Hidden Games.** Games you hide no longer appear on Home, in the Library or in Search; they are listed here with their cover, and **Show** (or ✕ on the controller) brings them back. The per-PC "Show Hidden Games" switch is gone.
- A hidden Steam game no longer reappears in the Library as "Not Installed".
